designationHistory.name: Pisgah National Game Preserve
designationHistory.indexText: President Wilson set aside the Weeks Act lands of the Pisgah National Forest, North Carolina, for the protection of game animals, birds and fish as the Pisgah National Game Preserve.

authority.citation: Proclamation of Oct. 17, 1916, 39 Stat. 1811 (under Act of Aug. 11, 1916, 39 Stat. 446, 476)

designationHistory.note: govinfo files this proclamation as a second document beginning on page 1811 of volume 39; it may run onto page 1812.
